points.quote: Generative-Artificial Intelligence detection software will not normally be used in the operation of this procedure, to either evidence allegations of academic misconduct or as a tool in an investigation of academic misconduct.
points.gist: Generative AI detection software will not normally be used to evidence allegations or investigate academic misconduct under this procedure.

points.quote: Instruct students to complete and submit the Generative-Artificial Intelligence Declaration coversheet for all appropriate assessments
points.gist: Schools are to instruct students to complete and submit the Generative-Artificial Intelligence Declaration coversheet for all appropriate assessments.

points.quote: Plagiarism: using without acknowledgement another person’s words or ideas and submitting them for assessment as though it were one’s own work. This includes copying materials from the internet, unfair use of generative artificial intelligence software
points.gist: Plagiarism, which includes unfair use of generative AI software, is using others' words or ideas without acknowledgement and submitting them as one's own.

points.quote: The Panel of Enquiry must not normally consider information sourced from GenerativeArtificial Intelligence detection software.
points.gist: The Panel of Enquiry must not normally consider information sourced from generative AI detection software.

points.quote: Schools must provide students with guidance on any subject- or discipline-specific examples of academic misconduct.
points.gist: Schools must give students guidance on subject- or discipline-specific examples of academic misconduct.

points.quote: make acknowledgements in submitted work as required by the University and/or their subject or discipline (e.g. to sources, methods, translation, use of generative artificial intelligence software)
points.gist: Students make acknowledgements in submitted work as required, including of generative AI software use.
